Subject: Private patching sprint — cross-org matrix & network preflight

Team,

We are kicking off the planning thread for the Private deployment patching sprint (version pin bump from 3.4.2 -> 3.5.0 for controlplane + model-serving). This thread is to capture the cross-org action matrix and surface network/VLAN changes that NetOps and Orion SRE need to coordinate on.

Proposed maintenance window (please flag conflicts):
- Jan 10, 2027 02:00 - 04:00 UTC (02:00 startup, 03:30 canary validation, 04:00 complete)

High-level asks:
- NetOps (acmecorp): confirm VLAN/BGP community change and firewall rule temporary window; provide expected time-to-propagate for on-prem routers.
- Orion SRE: confirm blackout/quiet window and any customer-facing read-only tolerances for 00:00-06:00 UTC that day.
- Infra/Platform (internal): owners for canary execution, rollback validation, and post-mortem.

Attachments: preflight checklist + VLAN diagram + canary test plan. See also JIRA-OPS-9341 and the Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Private+Patching+Sprint+Runbook

Immediate asks (please reply by EOD Jan 5):
1) Sign off on the window or propose alternate 2-hour window within Jan 8-12.
2) NetOps: confirm whether a BGP community swap is required or if static route injection is acceptable. If BGP, provide exact communities and hold times.
3) Owners: nominate primary and backup for rollback checklist execution.

I am assigning preliminary owners below — confirming needed:
- Canary lead: Monica Patel
- Rollback lead: Neha Kapoor
- Network liaison: Karthik Iyer

Thanks — want to get this nailed down early so we can lock vendor change windows and send invites.

—
Connor O'Brien
Senior Infrastructure PM
Redwood Inference

Connor — thanks for the clear kickoff. A few specifics from the platform side:

1) Canary plan
- We'll spin up 3 canary nodes in the customer-dedicated VPC (same placement as prior canary runs).
- Canary test plan attached (canary-test-plan.xlsx): smoke generation (100 req/min), KV-cache warm, a short eval run against 10 golden prompts.
- We need a 45-minute validation window after the patch to ensure no model inference regressions; propose the timeline in the original window (03:30 validation).

2) IPs & NAT
- Please provide the exact egress IP ranges NetOps will hand to Orion for firewall white-listing. We cannot use ephemeral NATs for the canary — need stable NAT during the window.

3) Staging preflight
- We'll run an identical patch on staging Jan 6th during a 60-minute window and dump telemetry. Please record the run so Orion SRE can review before Jan 10.

Owners: I accept Canary lead; backup will be Soojin Lee.

Connor / Monica,

Thanks for the heads-up. A few clarifying questions from our side before we lock in the window:

1) BGP vs static routes: we prefer a short static route injection for the maintenance window to avoid long convergence delays. If Redwood needs BGP community changes for session steering, provide the exact communities and confirm that the customer border routers will accept them.

2) Firewall window: we can open the firewall entries for the 02:00-05:00 UTC slab to give you 1 hour post-window buffer; confirm the minimum required rollback hold time so we can schedule reversion.

3) VLAN change and ARP reconvergence: the diagram attached shows a required VLAN tag adjustment on the aggregator switch. Expect ~45s of ARP flapping on downstream racks; please confirm whether that is acceptable for the canary nodes.

4) Contact & escalation: On-call engineer for this change will be Priya N. (pri_netops@acmecorp.com), phone +1-415-555-0199.

Once we have confirmation on the above, we'll issue a formal change request in our CMDB and provide a change ticket ID.

Regards,
Acme NetOps Change Coordinator
acmecorp-netops@acmecorp.com

Couple of operational guardrails and rollback criteria from my side:

Rollback (immediate abort) triggers:
- >= 5x increase in 5m P95 latency for inference requests from baseline for 10 minutes
- >= 3% sustained error rate (5xx) for 5 minutes on canary traffic
- KV cache corruption observed in logs or cache consistency checks fail

Soft abort / hold and triage:
- Error spike < 3% but persistent for > 15 minutes
- One of the canary nodes loses connectivity to the model shard (network flapping)

Metrics & dashboards to watch (we will create a short dashboard):
- Inference p50/p95, error rate, CPU/GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio
- Network retransmits and BGP session flaps (NetOps)

Runbook references: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Private+Patching+Sprint+Runbook (see section "Abort & Rollback")

I will add the maintenance-window .ics and request signoffs. Also proposing a 30-minute quiet window before the start where no deployments or config changes are performed in the account.
